title: Beta Ensembles in the Freezing Regime and Finite Free Convolutions
summary: In the freezing regime where the system size N is fixed and the inverse temperature beta tends to infinity, the eigenvalues of Gaussian beta ensembles converge to zeros of the Nth Hermite polynomial. That law of large numbers has been proved by analyzing the joint density or reading off the random matrix model. This paper studies its dynamical version of this phenomenon.
